title: Construction of Non-special Divisors on Kummer Covers With Arbritary Ramification For LCP Codes
summary: Linear Complementary Pairs (LCP) of algebraic geometry (AG) codes offer strong resistance against side-channel and fault-injection attacks, but their construction depends critically on the explicit identification of non-special divisors of degree $g$ and $g-1$. Existing constructions are restricted to Kummer extensions where divisors are supported exclusively on totally ramified places, significantly limiting the range of applicable function fields and codes.
